title: 10 tactics that actually work to get backlinks to your site in 2027
summary: Here’s how to get quality backlinks to your website + what real SEO practitioners are saying still drives results.
body_markdown:
## Start building high-quality backlinks


Backlinks are essential for SEO. They’re also valuable for helping AI systems recognize your relevance.


But finding sites worth pitching, and writing up those pitches, takes hours — hours most people don't have.


The Link-Building Assistant does the tough work for you: It reads pages on your site, finds content worth linking to, tracks down a real contact, and drafts the email. All that’s left for you to do is send the email.


### Get your free Link-Building Assistant


Run the Link-Building Assistant inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or your coding agent of choice.


It'll find the best page for earning backlinks or tell you what to build if nothing qualifies yet.


Then it searches the web, tracks down a real contact, and writes the pitch. You just hit send.


### How to use your Link-Building Assistant


**For use in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot:** Download the lite-prompt.md file and upload it to your AI assistant.


Then enter “Run the Link Building Assistant.” Your Link-Building Assistant will ask for your URL and start finding link building opportunities.


**For use in Claude Code or Codex:** Download the .zip file, open it, and add the new folder to your AI assistant.


Then type “Run the Link Building Assistant.”


The tool will ask for your URL to begin the analysis.


Some AI assistants pause to ask a question or confirm permission first — answer and the tool keeps going.


Then, it picks the page worth promoting and finds sites that would genuinely benefit from linking to it. Once you approve a prospect, it drafts the outreach email for you to send from your own email.
